<thought>We have the AFM API snippet showing how to set scan and Z‑controller parameters. We just need to provide a Python code string that sets the requested PID gains (P = 100, I = 6000, D = 10) and the scanning parameters (time per line = 0.1 s, lines per frame = 128). The code will import the nanosurf package, obtain the application object, adjust the parameters, and then clean up.</thought>
<final_answer>import nanosurf

# Initialize the AFM system
spm = nanosurf.SPM()          # or nanosurf.C3000(), nanosurf.CX(), etc.
app = spm.application

# Access scan and Z‑controller objects
scan = app.Scan
zcontrol = app.ZController

# ---- Scanning parameters ----
scan.Scantime = 0.1   # Time per line [s]
scan.Lines = 128      # Lines per frame

# (Optional: keep other scan settings unchanged)

# ---- PID gains ----
zcontrol.PGain = 100   # Proportional gain
zcontrol.IGain = 6000  # Integral gain
zcontrol.DGain = 10    # Derivative gain

# Clean up
del spm</final_answer>
